items.title: 4.2 Mole, molar mass aur Avogadro's number ka taalluq (Roman Urdu)

source_refs.note: Roman Urdu explanation of topic 4.2, printed pages 76-78.

blocks.text: Qudrati carbon ke 12.0 g ke namoone mein utne hi atoms hain jitne qudrati helium ke 4.0 g mein: dono mein atoms ka ek mole hai, 6.02 x 10^23. Anasir ke mukhtalif masses mein atoms ki tadaad ek jaisi hai: hydrogen ka 1.0 g, sodium ka 23.0 g aur uranium ka 238.0 g har ek ek mole hai, 6.02 x 10^23 atoms. Sodium ka atom hydrogen ke atom se 23 guna bhari hai, to atoms ki barabar tadaad ke liye sodium mass mein 23 guna zyada lena hoga. Isi tarah pani ka 18.0 g aur glucose ka 180.0 g har ek ek mole hai, 6.02 x 10^23 molecules: mukhtalif compounds ke ek mole ke masses mukhtalif hain magar molecules ki tadaad ek jaisi. Mukhtalif ionic species ke ek mole mein ions ki tadaad bhi hamesha Avogadro's number hai: sulfate ions ka 96.1 g aur nitrate ions ka 62.0 g har ek 6.02 x 10^23 ions hain.

Moles ki tadaad zarraat ki tadaad ko Avogadro's number se taqseem kar ke nikalti hai: n = N / NA. Taalluqat mila kar, zarraat ki tadaad = (madde ka mass x NA) / molar mass. Grams mein mass taqseem molar mass moles deta hai, aur moles zarb Avogadro's number zarraat ki tadaad.

blocks.alt: Ek qatar mein teen gehre neele dabbe: baen taraf 'Mass in grams', beech mein 'Moles' aur daen taraf 'No. of Particles'. Ek surmai teer Moles se Mass in grams ki taraf hai, us par 'x Molar mass' likha hai. Doosra surmai teer Moles se No. of Particles ki taraf hai, us par 'x Avogadro's number' likha hai.
blocks.caption: Grams mein mass, moles aur zarraat ki tadaad (kitab ke safha 77 par chhape khaake ke mutabiq asal khaaka).

blocks.title: Diagram ko samjhein
blocks.text: Moles beech mein hain. Moles ko molar mass se zarb dein to grams mein mass milta hai; moles ko Avogadro's number (6.02 x 10^23) se zarb dein to zarraat (particles) ki tadaad milti hai. Ulta jaane ke liye taqseem karein: mass / molar mass = moles, aur particles / 6.02 x 10^23 = moles.

rows: Juglone C10H6O3 ka molar mass aur 0.87 g mein moles

blocks.title: Dilchasp maloomat
blocks.text: Juglone, kale akhrot ke chhilkon se rang, ek qudrati herbicide (ghaas-kush) hai: yeh darakht ke gird muqabla karne wale paudon ko marta hai magar ghaas ko nahi. Isopentyl acetate, C7H14O2, kelon ko un ki khushbu deta hai, aur shehad ki makhi dank marte waqt is ka taqreeban 1 x 10^-6 g chhorti hai, jo doosri makhiyon ko hamle ke liye kheenchta hai.

blocks.prompt: Tanbe ki taar mein 27.10 x 10^25 copper atoms hain. Moles nikalein. Phir 1 x 10^-6 g isopentyl acetate, C7H14O2, mein molecules, aur un mein carbon, hydrogen aur oxygen ke atoms nikalein.
blocks.explanation: Copper: 27.10 x 10^25 / 6.02 x 10^23 = 450 mol. Isopentyl acetate: M = 7 x 12 + 14 x 1 + 2 x 16 = 130 g/mol; 1 x 10^-6 / 130 = 7.7 x 10^-9 mol; molecules = 7.7 x 10^-9 x 6.02 x 10^23 = 4.6 x 10^15. Har molecule mein 7 C, 14 H aur 2 O hain, to 3.2 x 10^16 carbon atoms, 6.5 x 10^16 hydrogen atoms aur 9.3 x 10^15 oxygen atoms.

items: Kisi bhi cheez ke ek mole mein 6.02 x 10^23 zarraat hain chahe mass kuch bhi ho: 1.0 g H, 23.0 g Na, 238.0 g U, 18.0 g H2O, 180.0 g glucose, 96.1 g sulfate ions.
n = N / NA aur N = (m x NA) / M: mass taqseem molar mass moles deta hai, moles zarb Avogadro's number zarraat.
